must_fix.title: Dialog does not return focus to the trigger when content autofocuses (autoFocus or a child focusing in its own effect)
must_fix.evidence:
src/Dialog/Dialog.tsx:58 saves `previous = document.activeElement` in a useEffect, which runs after React has applied autoFocus to a child, so `previous` is an element inside the dialog. On close it has been removed from the page and the restore is skipped. Probe: trigger button plus containing ; click trigger, press Escape. `npx vitest run src/__probe__` printed `focused after close:
`. The same probe without autoFocus restores to . The issue requires returning focus to whatever had it before opening. No test covers this.

nits: Tabs: a disabled defaultValue tab gets aria-selected=true and tabIndex=-1 while another tab is the tab stop, contradicting 'only the selected tab is in the tab order' (the README documents the fallback).
Dialog always focuses the first focusable element and overrides a child's autoFocus.
Dialog's focusable-element list leaves out contenteditable, summary, iframe and media controls, and includes disabled buttons that have an explicit tabindex.
Combobox silently overwrites a consumer-supplied `id` although the README says the remaining input props are forwarded.
Combobox: Enter with typed text and no active option throws the text away (documented).
tsconfig includes an empty tests/ directory while the new tests live in src/.

report:
I can't merge this yet. There's one must-fix bug: when the Dialog contains an element with `autoFocus`, closing it leaves focus on `` instead of returning it to the button that opened it. Everything else held up. `pnpm test` passes 76 of 76 tests across 3 files, and `pnpm typecheck` passes. **Must fix: Dialog loses the focus return when a child uses `autoFocus`** `src/Dialog/Dialog.tsx:58` saves `document.activeElement` inside a `useEffect`. React applies `autoFocus` while it builds the page, before that effect runs. So the saved "previous" element is the input inside the dialog, not the trigger. When the dialog closes, that input is removed from the page, the restore is skipped, and focus falls to ``. The same thing happens if any child moves focus in its own effect, because a child's effects run before the parent's. The issue asks the dialog to "return focus to whatever had it before opening." To reproduce it, I added a temporary test in `src/__probe__/probe.test.tsx` (now deleted). It renders a trigger button and a Dialog with ``, clicks the trigger, then presses Escape: ``` npx vitest run src/__probe__ focused after open: focused after close:
``` Without `autoFocus` the same probe works, including under StrictMode (`strict close: `). The fix is to save the previous focus before the dialog content mounts, for example in `Dialog` while `open` is switching to true, or in a layout effect on a wrapper that mounts before the children. A regression test should be added with it. **Edge cases that behaved correctly:** - **Tabs:** with no `defaultValue`, the first *enabled* tab is selected. - **Combobox inside a Dialog:** the first Escape closes only the listbox and the second closes the dialog. - **Nested dialogs:** Escape and backdrop events from the inner dialog are kept away from the outer one. - **Combobox, everything filtered out is disabled:** ArrowDown leaves no active option. **Nits (not blocking):** - **Disabled default tab:** with `defaultValue` pointing at a disabled tab, that tab gets `aria-selected=true` but `tabIndex=-1`, and a different tab becomes the tab stop. This contradicts "only the selected tab is in the tab order", though the README documents the fallback. - **Dialog ignores `autoFocus`:** it always focuses the first focusable element, so `autoFocus` on a child doesn't work. - **Dialog focus trap:** the list of focusable elements leaves out `[contenteditable]`, `summary`, `iframe` and `audio/video[controls]`. It also lets in disabled buttons that have an explicit `tabindex`. - **Combobox `id`:** a consumer's `id` is silently overwritten by the generated one, although the README says the remaining input props are forwarded. - **Combobox Enter:** pressing Enter with typed text and no active option throws the text away without a word. The README documents this. - **Empty `tests/` directory:** `tsconfig.json` includes `tests/`, but the new tests sit next to the components in `src/`. `. The same probe without autoFocus restores to . The issue requires returning focus to whatever had it before opening.
